thread:
jamie: Heads up — new tenant onboarding (AcmeAI) needs NDv4 capacity in EU. I opened quota requests but hit capacity limits in westeurope. Need quota + reservation advice.

rachel: Which subscriptions and tickets?

jamie: Subscriptions: `sub-analytics-001`, `sub-prod-nd-02`. Tickets I opened: 2026-AZ-8472 (quota increase NDv4 westeurope), 2026-AZ-8473 (capacity reservation NDv4 westeurope). Also NC-series for staging: creating separate ticket.

simon: Westeurope NDv4 stock is tight this week — we should plan a cross-region fallback. Northeurope has some NC/ND availability; eastus2 is more plentiful but higher latency for EU users.

jamie: Latency matters for Acme's product. Northeurope is acceptable. For production we want 6x ND40rs steady for 2 weeks, with ability to burst to 10 during morning windows (08:00-11:00 CET). Staging needs 4x NC24s.

irene: I can escalate with our TAM. Please DM me subscription GUIDs, preferred reservation window, and expected throughput (vCPU/GPU counts). I'll attach to the escalation.

jamie: GUIDs (shortened): `9f3a1b2c-xxxx-xxxx`, `b28c4d5e-xxxx-xxxx`. Steady: 6 ND40rs (~384 vGPU cores), burst to 10. Staging: 4 NC24s. Also need NSG / connection limits raised for the nodepools (we hit 4096 conn limit).

azsupport-bot: Ticket 2026-AZ-8472 updated: "Capacity advisory: limited NDv4 inventory in westeurope. Recommend reservation or cross-region fallback."

rachel: Can we bundle quota + NSG + capacity reservation into one enterprise escalation so Azure routes to capacity planning faster? Also ask for start date and whether they can guarantee hardware for the window.

jamie: Good idea. Created NSG ticket 2026-AZ-8474 for port/conn limits (request: increase to 50k concurrent connections for cluster nodes). Adding that to the escalation.

ops-oncall: Cost check: reserving 6 ND40rs full-time is ~ $1.2M/month estimate. Suggest hybrid: reserve 3, keep 3 as on-demand burst with planned autoscaling — much cheaper. Run Optimize for exact numbers.

jamie: Agree. For now request reservation for 3 ND40rs (primary), ask quota bump to allow up to 10 in region for burst. I'll run Optimize and post the cost delta.

irene: Escalation email drafted and sent to TAM, referencing tickets 2026-AZ-8472 / 8473 / 8474 and subs `sub-analytics-001` & `sub-prod-nd-02`. I asked for a response within 48 hours and put in a premium chargeback routing.

simon: I'll add terraform changes for region-priority fallback. Plan to introduce a variable: `region_priority = ["westeurope", "northeurope", "eastus2"]` and a toggle to enable reservation vs on-demand.

jamie: Terraform snippet I used for capacity (FYI):

```
resource "azurerm_reservation" "ndv4_res" {
  sku = "ND40rs_v4"
  region = var.region
  quantity = var.reserved_count
  start_date = var.reserve_start
  end_date = var.reserve_end
}
```

jamie: Internal note — please react with :thumbsup: if you own a follow-up item.

rachel: :thumbsup:

irene: :thumbsup:

simon: :eyes:

azsupport-bot: Ticket 2026-AZ-8473 status changed to "Escalated to Capacity Planning". Estimated response ETA 36-72 hours.

jamie: Created internal follow-up INFRA-2298 to track approvals, cost model, terraform changes, and cutover runbook. I'll update once TAM responds.

ops-oncall: Added a note to INFRA-2298: simulate 3-reserve + 3-burst and 0-reserve + 6-burst to compare 30/60/90 day spend. Use Optimize and tagging to measure exact token-level costs.

jamie: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the Acme onboarding quota batch.
